name: Sunlord-sdfl
title: SDFL series multilayer chip ferrite inductors, 0402 to 1206
summary: Magnetically shielded multilayer ferrite chip inductors in four case sizes: SDFL1005 (0402), SDFL1608 (0603), SDFL2012 (0805) and SDFL3216 (1206). Values run from 0.047 µH up to 3.3 µH in 0402, 33 µH in 0603 and 47 µH in 0805 and 1206, each offered at ±7, ±10, ±15 or ±20 % tolerance. Each value carries a minimum Q at its test frequency, a minimum self-resonant frequency, a maximum DC resistance and a maximum rated current, and the series operates from -40 °C to +85 °C.

pins.function: Termination at one end of the chip.
Termination at the other end; the chip mounts in either direction.

operation.text: Monolithic multilayer ferrite construction, rated for high reliability. A magnetic shield keeps the inductor from coupling to neighbouring parts.
The chip has no orientation to observe when placing it. It takes either reflow or wave soldering, solders readily and withstands the soldering heat.
Intended applications: communications equipment, video and audio equipment, computers and remote controls.

The third field is the material code. L covers the lowest values (0.047 µH to 0.33 µH in 1005, to 0.82 µH in the other sizes). In 1005, Q also covers 0.39 µH to 0.82 µH. P covers 1.0 µH to 2.2 µH in 1005, 1608 and 2012; Q covers 1.0 µH to 3.3 µH in 1005 and 1.0 µH to 4.7 µH in the other sizes. S covers 5.6 µH to 12 µH and T 15 µH to 47 µH (to 33 µH in 1608). Where P and Q share a value, the P part has the higher minimum self-resonant frequency.

Inductance and Q are measured at 50 MHz for the L values below 0.1 µH and at 25 MHz for the L values from 0.1 µH, at 10 MHz for every P and Q value, and at 4 MHz (5.6 µH to 8.2 µH) or 2 MHz (10 µH, 12 µH) for S. T values are measured at 1 MHz from 15 µH to 27 µH, at 2 MHz for 39 µH and 47 µH, and at 33 µH at 1 MHz in 1608 and 0.4 MHz in 2012 and 3216.
The 0805 and 1206 sizes come in two heights. In 0805 the values from 27 µH up are 1.25 mm thick and the rest 0.85 mm; in 1206 the values from 33 µH up are 1.10 mm thick and the rest 0.85 mm.
